related_questions.question: What are the most common lingering COVID symptoms?

text_blocks.snippet: The most common lingering symptoms of COVID-19, often referred to as long COVID, include extreme tiredness (fatigue), problems with memory and concentration (brain fog), and dizziness or lightheadedness. Additionally, many individuals experience persistent breathing difficulties, cough, and sleep disturbances. Other lingering symptoms can include headaches, changes in taste or smell, and fast or irregular heartbeat according to the Mayo Clinic.
snippet_highlighted_words: extreme tiredness (fatigue), problems with memory and concentration (brain fog), and dizziness or lightheadedness

text_blocks.snippet: Long COVID symptoms can vary widely in severity and duration, with some individuals experiencing a fluctuating course where symptoms improve and worsen over time notes the Mayo Clinic. The World Health Organization (WHO) states that some people may develop new illnesses or experience exacerbation of existing conditions due to long COVID, including heart disease, mood disorders, and other conditions according to the Mayo Clinic.
